description: This file defines a class for Oracle database driver support within the ADOdb library, including connection management, query execution, transaction handling, and recordset operations specific to Oracle databases.

classes.name: ADODB_oracle
classes.description: Primary class providing Oracle-specific connection and transaction management for the ADOdb PHP library.

classes.name: ADORecordset_oracle
classes.description: Class representing a recordset returned from Oracle queries, with methods for fetching and metadata.

methods.name: DBDate
methods.description: Formats a PHP date as an Oracle TO_DATE string.

methods.name: DBTimeStamp
methods.description: Formats a PHP timestamp as an Oracle TO_DATE string with time.

methods.name: BindDate
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a date string for binding.

methods.name: BindTimeStamp
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a timestamp string for binding.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits a transaction, with option to rollback if needed.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Retrieves the last error message from Oracle operations.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Retrieves the last error code from Oracle operations.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Oracle database with detailed parameters.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the Oracle database.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query against the Oracle database.
